title: Content Compliance
subtitle: Exact keyword matching plus semantic sample matching; hits are blocked or audited per policy group
disabledAlert: Content compliance is disabled; requests will not be checked

testModal.title: Test Detection
testModal.placeholder: Enter text to check against keywords and semantic samples

words.wordExtra: Exact keyword match; case sensitivity is decided by the backend
words.groupExtra: Hits are handled by the selected policy group's action and risk level
words.emptyHint: Add keywords or import them in bulk; requests containing them are handled per the policy group action.

batch.title: Import Keywords
batch.linesExtra: Each line is treated as one keyword; blank lines are ignored

samples.textPlaceholder: Enter an example of content that should be flagged
samples.textExtra: Used as a reference for semantic matching; the closer it is to real violating text, the better
samples.buildVectorExtra: Semantic matching requires built vectors; a request hits when its similarity reaches the semantic threshold in Settings
samples.confirmBuildAll: Vectors for all review samples will be rebuilt, which may take a while. Continue?
samples.emptyHint: Add examples of violating content and build their vectors so semantically similar requests are detected.

groups.name: Name
groups.actionExtra: What happens when a keyword or sample in this group is hit
groups.riskExtra: Only used to label and filter audit logs; it does not change handling
groups.enabledExtra: When disabled, keywords and samples in this group no longer take part in detection
groups.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional; describe what this group is for
groups.blockWarning: Block rejects the matching request with an error and never forwards it upstream; Audit only records a log and lets the request through
groups.deleteDisabled: This policy group is still referenced by keywords or samples and cannot be deleted
groups.emptyHint: Create a policy group first, then add keywords or review samples to it.

logs.emptyHint: Each time a request hits a keyword or review sample, the result is recorded here.
